title: Kaali Topi Laal Rumaal
description: When an Indian commando finally collars a feared terrorist, he discovers that the man is only a pawn in a bigger scheme and his boss is on the loose.

title: Jagan
description: Jagan befriends two women on separate occasions and they both end up falling for him. When he finds out that the two are sisters, he is left in a dilemma. Things take a turn for the worse when some goons force him to marry the elder sister.

title: Agni Varsha
description: In a drought-stricken kingdom, two rival priests, Yavakri and Paravasu, try to appease the rain god through their respective methods that lead to adultery, treachery, and murder.

title: Fiffty Fiffty
description: Singh lives a wealthy lifestyle in India along with his wife and a son named Kumar. His relative Bihari is envious and successfully exchanges his son Kishan for Kumar.

title: Geet
description: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

title: Antim Nyay
description: Jay Singh tries to seek justice for his deceased father, but all his efforts go in vain. He falls in love with Seema, an editor of a newspaper, who helps him, despite the challenges, to seek justice.

title: Laila
description: As a young boy, Deshraj is sent away for higher studies to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But when he returns, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of his family's enemy.

title: Demon
description: Haunted by horrific dreams, Vignesh Shivan is surrounded by thoughts of his dreams and all the mysterious events that happen in it.

title: The Real Hunter
description: Viji and Priya are in love with each other, but Viji's father, who is an aspiring political leader, has promised him in marriage to Kavya, the daughter of his friend Rajashekar.

title: Blackmail
description: Kailash's uncle discovers a formula to save energy that will make him very wealthy. Meanwhile, Jeevan plots to get his fiancée, Asha, married to Kailash who falls in love with her.

title: Khel
description: A wealthy widow loses her son in a car accident. Years later, she hires a young man who retrieves her purse from a thief. Impressed by his honesty, she hires him, but the guy is a con who is hatching a plan to seize her property.

title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
description: Inspector Arjun Singh is assigned to a case involving the murders and sexual molestations of young girls, only to find that his son may be the prime suspect.

title: Ek Se Bure Do
description: Two petty thieves face-off against gangsters, bandits and police after forging a treasure map.

title: Falak
description: Ramnath is killed at his job and his employers do not offer compensation. The man's two sons grow up and plot revenge against the corrupt businessmen.
